title: Exact volumetric fill
description: A 100x60x60mm cavity must be completely filled by four blocks: A (50x60x60mm), B (50x30x60mm), C (50x30x30mm), D (50x30x30mm). Their volumes sum exactly to the cavity, so any valid answer leaves no gaps. No overlaps, no rotation, everything inside. Return the min-corner [x,y,z] of each block in millimeters.
